source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 11 (PDF 251-260), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Special Theory of Relativity) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Why was relativistic mechanics developed at the beginning of the 20th century?
(20vi sadi ke aaghaz mein relativistic mechanics kyun banayi gayi?)
blocks.explanation: Naye tajurbat ne dikhaya ke Newton ke qawaneen par mabni classical physics bohat chhote zarraat ya bohat tez raftaar wale mazahir ki wazahat nahi kar sakti. Relativistic mechanics ne zyada jaame (comprehensive) dhaancha diya.

book_ref.quote: could not explain phenomena involving extremely small particles or very high velocities

blocks.prompt:
2 Why is direction called a relative concept? Give an example.
(Direction (simt) ko nisbati (relative) tasawwur kyun kehte hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Simt observer par munhasir hai. Aap daayen taraf ball phenkein to saamne khare shakhs ko woh baayen taraf jaati nazar aati hai; aik hi harkat ki do observers ke liye alag simt hai.

book_ref.quote: This illustrates that direction is a relative concept.

blocks.prompt:
3 Can we say that an object is absolutely at rest? Explain with an example.
(Kya hum keh sakte hain ke koi jism mutlaq (absolute) saakin hai? Misaal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Sukoon aur harkat observer par munhasir hain. Chalti train ki deewarein musafiron ko saakin magar zameen wale ko harkat mein nazar aati hain. Har harkat observer ya frame ke lehaz se hai.

book_ref.quote: the walls of a moving train seem stationary to passengers inside the train

blocks.prompt:
4 Compare the path of a ball dropped in a train moving with uniform velocity as seen by an observer inside and an observer outside the train.
(Yaksaan velocity se chalti train mein giraayi gayi ball ka raasta andar wale aur bahar wale observer ke lehaz se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Andar ball seedhi neeche girti hai; bahar se projectile raasta nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: an observer outside the train will see the ball following a projectile path

rows: Train ke saath usi velocity vₒ se chalta hai.
Ball ko seedha neeche girta dekhta hai.
Ball ko projectile raaste par dekhta hai.
Ball chhorne wale point ke bilkul neeche girti hai.
Ball girne se pehle vₒt horizontal faasla tay karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5 A train moves with a uniform velocity of 25 m s⁻¹. A ball dropped in it reaches the floor in 0.5 s. Find the horizontal distance moved by the ball for an observer on the ground.
(Train 25 m s⁻¹ ki yaksaan velocity se chal rahi hai. Is mein giraayi gayi ball 0.5 s mein farsh tak pohanchti hai. Zameen wale observer ke liye ball ka horizontal faasla nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Horizontal faasla = vₒt = 25 × 0.5 = 12.5 m. Andar wala observer bhi 12.5 m chalta hai, is liye us ke liye ball bilkul neeche girti hai.

book_ref.quote: It travels a horizontal distance vₒt in time t it takes for the ball to reach the floor.

blocks.prompt:
6 Define a frame of reference and give two examples.
(Frame of reference ki definition likhein aur do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Frame of reference koi bhi coordinate system hai jis ke lehaz se paimaish ki jaye. Misalein: maiz ki position ke liye kamra; spaceship ki position ke liye door ke sitaron par mabni coordinate system.

book_ref.quote: a frame of reference is any coordinate system relative to which measurements are taken

blocks.prompt:
7 Is a car moving with uniform velocity relative to the Earth an inertial frame? Give a reason.
(Zameen ke lehaz se yaksaan velocity se chalti car kya inertial frame hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Aisi car mein rakha jism be-tawazun force ke baghair saakin rehta hai, yani law of inertia laagu hai. Inertial frame ke lehaz se yaksaan velocity wala har frame bhi inertial hai.

book_ref.quote: A body in a car moving with uniform velocity relative to the Earth also remains at rest

blocks.prompt:
8 Why does a car that is suddenly braked stop being an inertial frame?
(Achanak brake lagne wali car inertial frame kyun nahi rehti?)
blocks.explanation: Jab car achanak ruke ya accelerate kare to andar ka jism be-tawazun force ke baghair bhi saakin nahi rehta. Law of inertia laagu nahi rehta, is liye accelerated car non-inertial frame hai.

book_ref.quote: if the moving car is suddenly stopped or accelerated, the body inside no longer remains at rest

blocks.prompt:
9 The Earth rotates and revolves, yet it is used as an inertial frame. Why?
(Zameen ghoomti aur gardish karti hai, phir bhi use inertial frame kyun liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gardish ki wajah se Zameen asal mein non-inertial hai, magar is ka acceleration nisbatan kam hai, is liye ise inertial maana jata hai; is par jism be-tawazun force ke baghair saakin rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: it is often treated as an inertial frame due to its relatively small acceleration

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between the special and the general theory of relativity.
(Special aur general theory of relativity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Special theory inertial frames se, general theory accelerating frames se mutaalliq hai.

book_ref.quote: There is another theory, called the general theory of relativity

rows: Aik doosre ke lehaz se accelerate karte frames se mutaalliq.
Speed ke asraat: time dilation, length contraction, mass variation.
Gravity ka space aur time par asar, maslan sitaron ke paas roshni ka murna.

blocks.prompt:
11 What does the principle of relativity tell us about detecting absolute uniform motion?
(Principle of relativity mutlaq yaksaan harkat ko maloom karne ke baare mein kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke physics ke qawaneen tamam inertial frames mein aik jaise hain, yaksaan harkat wale observers yeh nahi bata sakte ke kaun saakin hai aur kaun harkat mein. Is liye mutlaq yaksaan harkat maloom nahi ki ja sakti.

book_ref.quote: implying that there is no way to detect absolute uniform motion

blocks.prompt:
12 A car moves with speed v and its flashlight is on. Do the driver and a man on the road measure different speeds for the light? Explain.
(Speed v se chalti car ki flashlight jal rahi hai. Kya driver aur sarak par khara aadmi roshni ki speed mukhtalif naapenge? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Principle of constancy of light ke mutabiq khala mein roshni ki speed tamam observers ke liye c hai, source ya observer ki harkat jo bhi ho. Dono c naapte hain, c + v nahi.

book_ref.quote: is measured same by two observers, one moving in the car with speed v and other standing on the road

blocks.prompt:
13 Why do space and time become relative in the special theory of relativity?
(Special theory of relativity mein space aur time nisbati (relative) kyun ho jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Roshni ki speed c tamam observers ke liye universal constant hai (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹). Is ke barabar rehne ke liye mukhtalif frames mein lambai aur waqt ki paimaish mukhtalif honi chahiye, is liye space aur time relative ho jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: Since c is constant, space and time become relative.

blocks.prompt:
14 A person in a train moving at constant velocity close to the speed of light holds a mirror in front of him. Will he see his reflection? Why?
(Roshni ki speed ke qareeb mustaqil velocity se chalti train mein aik shakhs apne saamne aaina pakarta hai. Kya woh apna aks dekhega? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Principle of relativity ke mutabiq train ke andar koi tajurba us ki mustaqil harkat maloom nahi kar sakta, aur roshni us ke lehaz se c par hi chalti hai, is liye aks aam tarah nazar aata hai. (Koi maaddi jism roshni ki speed tak nahi pohanch sakta.)

book_ref.quote: you will still see your reflection in the mirror

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki misaal mein train 'roshni ki speed' se chal rahi hai, jo mumkin nahi; book correction ke mutabiq train mustaqil velocity se, roshni ki speed ke qareeb, chal rahi hai. Asal nukta yeh hai ke yaksaan harkat ko andar se kisi tajurbe se maloom nahi kiya ja sakta.

blocks.prompt:
15 What is time dilation? Write its equation.
(Time dilation kya hai? Is ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Time dilation relative harkat wale observer ke liye waqt ke waqfe ka phail jana hai. Agar tₒ proper time ho to harkat wala observer t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) naapta hai, jo tₒ se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: time has dilated or stretched due to the relative motion of the observer

blocks.prompt:
16 Why is the dilated time t always greater than the proper time tₒ?
(Dilated time t hamesha proper time tₒ se zyada kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) mein v, c se kam hai, is liye √(1 − v²/c²) hamesha aik se kam hai. tₒ ko aik se chhote number se taqseem karne par t, tₒ se zyada aata hai.

book_ref.quote: is always less than one, so t is greater than

blocks.prompt:
17 Compare proper time and dilated time.
(Proper time aur dilated time ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Proper time events ke frame mein, dilated time relative harkat wale observer se naapa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Suppose an observer is stationary in an inertial frame and measures the time interval between two events in this frame.

rows: Events ke frame mein saakin observer naapta hai.
Events ke frame ke lehaz se harkat wala observer naapta hai.

blocks.prompt:
18 A process lasts 4.0 s in its own frame. How long does it last for an observer moving at 0.6 c relative to it?
(Aik process apne frame mein 4.0 s chalta hai. Us ke lehaz se 0.6 c se chalne wale observer ke liye kitna chalega?)

book_ref.quote: the time measured by the observer will not be

blocks.prompt:
19 Does time dilation apply to living things? Explain.
(Kya time dilation jaandaar cheezon par bhi laagu hota hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Time dilation tamam processes par laagu hai, physical, chemical aur biological. Relativistic speeds par insani jism ka budhapa bhi saakin observer ke lehaz se aahista hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Even the aging process of the human body is slowed by motion at very high speeds

blocks.prompt:
20 What is length contraction? In which direction does it occur?
(Length contraction kya hai? Yeh kis rukh mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar aap mustaqil faasle wale do points ke lehaz se harkat karein to faasla saakin halat se chhota nazar aata hai: ℓ = ℓₒ√(1 − v²/c²). Yeh sirf harkat ke rukh mein hota hai, amoodi rukh mein nahi.

book_ref.quote: This effect is known as length contraction.

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between proper length and contracted length.
(Proper length aur contracted length mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Proper length jism ke lehaz se saakin observer, contracted length relative harkat wala observer naapta hai.

book_ref.quote: is called the proper length

rows: Jism ke lehaz se saakin observer naapta hai.
Jism ke lehaz se speed v se chalne wala observer naapta hai.
Chhoti: ℓ = ℓₒ√(1 − v²/c²), sirf harkat ke rukh mein.

blocks.prompt:
22 A train is 120 m long at rest. Find its length as measured by an observer beside the track when it moves at 0.6 c.
(Aik train saakin halat mein 120 m lambi hai. Jab yeh 0.6 c se chale to patri ke kinare khara observer us ki lambai kitni naapega?)

book_ref.quote: If an object and an observer are in relative motion with speed v

blocks.prompt:
23 A metre rod is carried in a spaceship moving at 0.8 c, with the rod perpendicular to the direction of motion. What length does an observer at rest measure? Why?
(0.8 c se chalte spaceship mein metre rod harkat ke amoodi rakha hai. Saakin observer kitni lambai naapega? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: 1 m. Length contraction sirf harkat ke rukh mein hota hai; amoodi rukh mein koi contraction nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: no such contraction is observed perpendicular to the direction of motion

blocks.prompt:
24 What does the increase in mass at high speed tell us about the inertia of a body?
(Tez raftaar par mass ka barhna jism ke inertia ke baare mein kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is se maloom hota hai ke jism ka inertia (jumood) barh jata hai. Jaise jaise v, c ke qareeb aata hai, speed badalne ke liye zyada se zyada force chahiye.

book_ref.quote: The increase in mass indicates the increase in inertia that an object has at high speeds.

blocks.prompt:
25 A body of rest mass 3.0 kg moves at 0.8 c. Find its mass.
(3.0 kg rest mass wala jism 0.8 c se chalta hai. Us ka mass nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: An object whose mass is measured at rest is called its rest mass

blocks.prompt:
26 At what speed does the mass of a body become 1.25 times its rest mass?
(Kis speed par jism ka mass us ke rest mass ka 1.25 guna ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: m/mₒ = 1/√(1 − v²/c²) = 1.25, is liye √(1 − v²/c²) = 0.8, v²/c² = 0.36 aur v = 0.6 c.

book_ref.quote: will have an increased mass m when observed to be moving at speed v

blocks.prompt:
27 Why do we not notice relativistic effects in everyday life?
(Rozmarra zindagi mein relativistic asraat kyun mehsoos nahi hote?)
blocks.explanation: Rozmarra speeds c ke muqable mein bohat kam hain. Zameen ki orbital speed bhi sirf 30 km s⁻¹ hai jabke roshni 300,000 km s⁻¹; is liye Newton ke qawaneen chalte hain. Asraat sirf c ke qareeb chalne wale zarraat mein numayan hote hain.

book_ref.quote: This is why Newton's laws are valid in everyday situations.

blocks.prompt:
28 What is meant by the relativity of simultaneity?
(Relativity of simultaneity se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif jagahon par do events jo aik observer ke liye aik waqt (simultaneous) hon, doosre harkat karte frame ke observer ke liye aam tor par simultaneous nahi hote. Simultaneity frame par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: whether two events are seen as simultaneous depends on the observer's frame of reference

blocks.prompt:
29 In a moving train with light-operated doors, why does an observer outside see the back door open first?
(Roshni se khulne wale darwazon wali chalti train mein bahar wala observer pichhla darwaza pehle khulta kyun dekhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyan se roshni dono taraf aik hi speed c se jaati hai. Pichhla darwaza roshni ki taraf aur agla us se door ja raha hai, is liye bahar wale ke liye roshni pehle pichhle darwaze tak pohanchti hai.

book_ref.quote: This is because the back door is moving towards the light waves

blocks.prompt:
30 You are in a closed frame moving at constant velocity and cannot see any other frame. Can you find out whether you are moving?
(Aap mustaqil velocity se chalte band frame mein hain aur koi aur frame nazar nahi aata. Kya aap maloom kar sakte hain ke aap harkat mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Aise frame mein yeh jaanne ka koi tareeqa nahi ke aap harkat mein hain ya saakin, kyunke physics ke qawaneen tamam inertial frames mein aik jaise hain.

book_ref.quote: there is no way to know if you are moving or at rest

blocks.text: 11.4 The equivalence between mass and energy

blocks.prompt:
31 Write Einstein's mass-energy relation and define rest mass energy.
(Einstein ka mass-energy rishta likhein aur rest mass energy ki definition dein.)
blocks.explanation: E = mc², jahan E kul energy aur m mass hai jo speed par munhasir hai. Saakin jism ke mass mₒ ke barabar energy rest mass energy hai, Eₒ = mₒc².

book_ref.quote: is called its rest mass energy

blocks.prompt:
32 How is kinetic energy expressed in the special theory of relativity?
(Special theory of relativity mein kinetic energy kaise likhi jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kul energy mc², rest mass energy mₒc² se zyada hai. Yeh farq harkat ki wajah se hai aur yahi kinetic energy hai: K.E. = (m − mₒ)c².

book_ref.quote: is due to the motion, and it represents the kinetic energy of the mass

blocks.prompt:
33 Find the rest mass energy of 2.0 g of matter. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)
(2.0 g maadde ki rest mass energy nikalein. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: The total energy E and mass m of an object are related by the expression:

blocks.prompt:
34 A body gains 9.0 × 10¹⁰ J of energy. Find the increase in its mass. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)
(Aik jism 9.0 × 10¹⁰ J energy haasil karta hai. Us ke mass mein izafa nikalein. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Δm = ΔE/c² = 9.0 × 10¹⁰/9 × 10¹⁶ = 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ kg. Bari energy ke liye bhi tabdeeli bohat thori hai.

book_ref.quote: the change in mass m due to change in energy

blocks.prompt:
35 Why does a small change in mass correspond to a very large change in energy?
(Mass mein thori tabdeeli energy mein bohat bari tabdeeli ke barabar kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: ΔE = Δm c² mein mass ki tabdeeli ko c² = 9 × 10¹⁶ m² s⁻² se zarb diya jata hai jo bohat bari miqdaar hai. Is liye mass mein thori tabdeeli bhi energy mein bohat bari tabdeeli hai.

book_ref.quote: small changes in mass require very large changes in energy

blocks.prompt:
36 A 2.0 kg body moves at 0.8 c. Find its kinetic energy. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)
(2.0 kg ka jism 0.8 c se chalta hai. Us ki kinetic energy nikalein. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: As mc² is greater than mₒc²

blocks.prompt:
37 A spaceship travels to a star at half the speed of light. Why do its occupants record a shorter journey time than observers on the Earth?
(Aik spaceship roshni ki aadhi speed se sitare tak jata hai. Is ke musafir Zameen walon se kam waqt kyun record karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zameen ke lehaz se spaceship ki ghariyan aahista chalti hain, is liye wahan kam waqt guzarta hai. Musafiron ke liye safar ki lambai sukar jaati hai, is liye woh kam waqt mein tay karte hain. Dono nazariye aik hi nateeja dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The occupants of the spaceship record 7 years to reach their destination

blocks.prompt:
38 A spaceship travels to a star at 0.8 c. Observers on the Earth find that the journey takes 20 years. How many years do the occupants record?
(Aik spaceship 0.8 c se sitare tak jata hai. Zameen ke mutabiq safar 20 saal leta hai. Musafir kitne saal record karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Spaceship ka waqt = 20 × √(1 − 0.64) = 20 × 0.6 = 12 saal.

book_ref.quote: Let a spaceship be travelling to a star with half of the speed of light.

blocks.prompt:
39 Why is time called the fourth dimension in relativity? Give an example of its use.
(Relativity mein waqt ko chautha dimension kyun kehte hain? Is ke istemaal ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Waqt events ki tarteeb aur muddat naapta hai aur mutlaq nahi, is liye space ke teen dimensions ke saath ise chautha dimension maana jata hai. Misaal: jhoolte pendulum ki frequency ke liye waqt chahiye.

book_ref.quote: In the theory of relativity, time is not absolute; it is considered the fourth dimension.

blocks.prompt:
40 What is space-time, and how do massive bodies affect it?
(Space-time kya hai, aur bhaari ajsaam is par kya asar daalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Space-time aik riyazi model hai jo space aur time ko aik continuum mein jorta hai. Bhaari ajsaam ise mor dete hain, jaise bhaari ball kapre ki chaadar ko; jitna zyada mass, utna gehra kham.

book_ref.quote: We can hypothetically visualize this as a fabric sheet.

blocks.prompt:
41 What are geodesics? How do bodies move near a massive object according to Einstein?
(Geodesics kya hain? Einstein ke mutabiq bhaari jism ke qareeb ajsaam kaise chalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Geodesics mure space-time mein woh raaste hain jo plane geometry ki seedhi lines jaise hain. Gravity ki force ki bajaye ajsaam aur shuaaein geodesics par chalti hain; bhaari jism ke qareeb saakin ya aahista jism geodesic par us ki taraf jata hai.

book_ref.quote: analogous to straight lines in plane geometry

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is Einstein's theory of gravity considered an advancement over Newton's?
(Einstein ki gravity theory ko Newton ki theory se aage ka qadam kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Newton ne inverse square law di magar us ki wajah nahi batayi. Einstein ki theory bhi yeh law deti hai (taqatwar fields ke siwa) aur wajah bhi batati hai, yani gravity ki tabeei tasweer deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Newton discovered the inverse square law of gravity

blocks.prompt:
43 Which theory describes the bending of light around a star? Why not the special theory?
(Sitare ke ird gird roshni ka murna kis theory se bayan hota hai? Special theory se kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: General theory of relativity. Special theory sirf inertial frames mein speed ke asraat bayan karti hai; gravity ka space aur time par asar, jaise sitaron se roshni ka murna, general theory mein aata hai.

book_ref.quote: are described by Einstein's general theory of relativity

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ke 11.5 mein likha hai ke special theory gravity aur roshni ke murne ko bayan karti hai; yeh book correction ke mutabiq durust nahi. Gravity wala hissa general theory ka hai.

blocks.prompt:
44 Why does a star seen near the Sun appear shifted from its true position?
(Sooraj ke qareeb nazar aane wala sitara apni asal jagah se hata hua kyun dikhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sitare ki roshni Zameen ki taraf aate hue Sooraj ke qareeb se guzarte waqt mur jaati hai, is liye sitara thore zaviye se hata hua nazar aata hai. Einstein ne 1.745 seconds of angle bataya jo 1919 ke suraj grahan mein durust nikla.

book_ref.quote: We see the star in the apparent direction B, shifted by the angle

blocks.prompt:
45 What are gravitational waves? When were they detected?
(Gravitational waves kya hain? Yeh kab detect hui?)
blocks.explanation: Gravitational waves space-time ke kham mein khalal (sukarna aur phailna) hain jo kuch falaki (celestial) waqiaat se paida hoti hain. Yeh 2015 mein detect hui aur 2016 mein elaan hua.

book_ref.quote: produced by some celestial events causing disturbances (squeezes and stretches)

blocks.prompt:
46 A pendulum has a period of 2.0 s in its own frame. What period is measured by an observer moving at 0.8 c relative to it?
(Aik pendulum ka apne frame mein period 2.0 s hai. Us ke lehaz se 0.8 c se chalne wala observer kitna period naapega?)

book_ref.quote: The period of a pendulum is measured to be 3.0 s in the inertial reference frame of the pendulum.
